groups.rationale: Lock and fixed-output hash repair for the Hegel migration: restores the registry-exact ash/crux entries and the transitive stream_data entry Ash 3.33.6 requires in Marshall and Lilly, records hegel_ex by its full commit SHA instead of the short ref Mix rejects, and refreshes every application's reviewed Mix dependency hash; no direct dependency, release behavior, hash policy or deployment topology changes.
